A music school needs five tables. A lesson booking ties one pupil to one class, and a teacher runs several classes.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    PUPIL ||--o{ ENROLMENT : "holds"
    TERM ||--o{ ENROLMENT : "covers"
    PUPIL ||--o{ LESSON : "books"
    CLASS ||--o{ LESSON : "is booked for"
    TEACHER ||--o{ CLASS : "runs"

    PUPIL {
        int pupil_id PK
        string first_name
        string last_name
        string email UK
        date joined
        enum status
    }
    TERM {
        int term_id PK
        string name UK
        decimal fee
        int weeks
    }
    ENROLMENT {
        int enrolment_id PK
        int pupil_id FK
        int term_id FK
        date start_date
        bool auto_renew
    }
    TEACHER {
        int teacher_id PK
        string name
        string instrument
    }
    CLASS {
        int class_id PK
        int teacher_id FK
        string weekday
        time start_time
        int capacity
    }
    LESSON {
        int lesson_id PK
        int pupil_id FK
        int class_id FK
        datetime booked_at
    }
```

`CLASS` holds the weekly slot, `LESSON` one pupil's place in it.
